facts.text: The lady at the next table orders one too
facts.why: In the film the woman at the next table says 'I'll have what she's having' after Sally fakes the orgasm. She does not order an egg cream, and Sally is eating a sandwich.
facts.fix: The lady at the next table will have what you're having

facts.why: Sally orders the chef's salad and heated apple pie with everything on the side at the diner on the drive, and later jokes about her 'on the side' habit, so 'exactly as she orders it' is true to her character.
facts.fix: Exactly as she ordered it on the drive

facts.text: Harry's order. Hand cut, piled high, a pickle on the side
facts.why: Nothing shows the pastrami is Harry's order: the transcript has no food at Katz's, one article calls the pastrami Sally's and another says she has turkey. The Katz's pastrami is the safe claim.
facts.fix: The Katz's classic. Hand cut, piled high, a pickle on the side

facts.why: Sally's plan in the car is an 18-hour trip and Harry says they have 18 hours to kill before New York; the argument is a joke.

vibe.verdict: Great idea to use a Katz's check, but it mixes the diner order into the deli and misreads the egg cream gag.
missing: Sally's diner order on the side (the drive)
The New Year's Eve run to the party (finale)
Send a salami to your boy in the army (Katz's sign)
ideas: Swap the egg cream line 'The lady at the next table orders one too' for 'Order what she's having.'
Move the chef salad and apple pie to a separate 'The diner' check, replacing the Katz's check lines.
Swap 'Fried pickles' for a pecan pie slice from the museum scene.
Replace the busy photo collage with two stills and a bigger check.
